title: Momentum
criteria: Multiply mass by velocity with correct units.
Distinguish zero total momentum from no motion.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A 7 kg cart moves at 3 m/s. What is momentum magnitude?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A sample has momentum magnitude 15 kg·m/s and mass 2.5 kg. What is its speed?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Take east as positive. A 3 kg object moves west at 4 m/s. What is momentum?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Two carts have momenta +9 and −5 kg·m/s. What is total momentum?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A 2 kg cart at +5 m/s and a 5 kg cart at −2 m/s form a system. What is its total momentum?
options: Zero, so both carts are stationary.
Zero, even though both carts are moving.
cpa.guide: Their momenta +10 and −10 cancel, not their individual motions.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: A system’s total momentum is zero. Which motion is possible?
options: Two objects moving with equal and opposite momenta.
Only a state where every object is at rest.
A single positive-mass object moving at nonzero velocity.
cpa.guide: Zero vector sum can include nonzero individual vectors.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.
